item.title: US used dioxin-laden oil for dust control in a town with 2,000 residents, only to spend $33.1 million for their relocation in order to protect their lives
item.description: The residents of Times Beach faced a critical situation when dioxin contamination was discovered, leading to their permanent relocation. Originally, this toxic substance was used on dirt roads for dust control during the 1970s. A devastating flood in 1982 heightened the community's concerns about contamination. To address the issue, an incinerator was constructed to manage over 265,000 tons of polluted materials. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Firefighters keep battling wildfire in France’s Landes region
item.description: Firefighters and local farmers are working through the night to contain a wildfire in Luglon, in southwestern France, which has already burned more than 1,500 hectares. item.title: Hugo Castaneda ha comentado: 🙏🔥 *NO DEJEMOS PARA MAÑANA LO QUE DIOS NOS ESTÁ PIDIENDO HOY.* La vida es como un soplo. En un segundo puede pasar: Un *accidente* en la calle Un *infarto* sin avisar Una *bala perdida* Un *terremoto* Cualquier cosa... Y si partimos sin Cristo... *nos vamos a la eternidad sin Él*. Eso es lo más triste y lo que más debe dolernos. *La Biblia lo dice clarito:* *SANTIAGO 4:14* _Porque ¿qué es vuestra vida? Ciertamente es neblina que se aparece por un poco de tiempo, y luego se desvanece._ *HEBREOS 9:27* _Y de la manera que está establecido para los hombres que mueran una sola vez, y después de esto el juicio._ *2 CORINTIOS 6:2* _He aquí ahora el tiempo aceptable; he aquí ahora el día de salvación._ *¿Entonces qué hacemos hoy?* 1. *Arrepentirnos* de corazón y pedirle perdón a Dios 2. *Recibir a Jesús* como Señor y Salvador 3. *Vivir cada día como si fuera el último* para Él 4. *Hablarle a otros* para que tampoco lo dejen para después Amigos , *hoy es el día*. No sabemos si habrá mañana. HCU

item.description: A significant earthquake registering 7.7 on the Richter scale rocked eastern Indonesia early Saturday, claiming the lives of at least thirty-eight individuals and leading to the destruction of various structures. item.title: Heathrow passengers face disruption after flood restricts access
item.description: Airport advises passengers travelling from terminals 2 and 3 to use rail and tube as pipe leak closes road Heathrow airport has warned of disruption after flooding caused by a pipe leak restricted access to terminals 2 and 3. Water in the central terminal area means anyone trying to travel to or from either terminal is unable enter by road. Passengers are being advised to travel by rail and tube instead. Access to the terminal car parks is also impeded, leaving passengers with parked cars unable to access them. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: The ground beneath Poland's wind turbines became nesting grounds for wild bees
item.description: In Poland, the bases of wind turbines have emerged as surprising havens for pollinators. Research highlights that these zones foster a thriving community of wild bees and a variety of plant species. The bare gravel and low maintenance create perfect nesting sites for ground-nesting bees. While butterflies opt for grasslands, both flies and grasslands flourish equally in these overlooked yet vital habitats for biodiversity on farmland. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Un terremoto de magnitud 7,7 sacude el mar frente a Indonesia; hay cinco muertos y numerosos daños
item.description: Un potente sismo de magnitud 7,7 sacudió la madrugada del sábado el este de Indonesia, ha informado el Servicio Geológico de Estados Unidos (USGS). Hay al menos veinte personas muertas .El epicentro del terremoto, que se produjo a las 05.58 hora local (medianoche en España) a poca profundidad frente a la isla de Flores, se encuentra a 68 kilómetros de la ciudad de Ende, en la provincia de Nusa Tenggara Oriental, según el USGS. El sismo inicial fue seguido por dos fuertes réplicas en la misma zona, de magnitudes 5,6 y 5,9.La Agencia de Meteorología, Climatología y Geofísica de Indonesia (BMKG)… Publicado también por: ABC España - Internacional, Clarín - Mundo. Fuente: El Mundo - Internacional.

item.title: Five dead after 7.7 magnitude earthquake strikes Indonesia
item.description: Quake struck Flores region early on Saturday, prompting thousands to seek higher ground for fear of a tsunami A 7.7-magnitude earthquake struck eastern Indonesia early on Saturday, killing at least 38 people, causing widespread panic and collapsing buildings and homes in a region prone to deadly seismic events. Authorities issued a tsunami warning, which has since been lifted, but there have been dozens of aftershocks, including one of magnitude of 6.1. Indonesian authorities said that monitoring showed no significant sea level changes that could indicate a tsunami. Continue reading... item.title: Hong Kong’s biodiversity ‘richer than we know’ but many species lack protection
item.description: Hong Kong’s lush forests are teeming with more wildlife ranging from birds arriving from neighbouring regions to newly discovered reptile and insect species, experts have found, as they urge authorities to devise a conservation list to protect vulnerable local species. The call by the city’s conservationists to formulate a “red list” – a long-awaited measure since 2014 – coincided with National Ecology Day on Saturday.
